scope: Read-only inventory and fixed red-mask scoreability of saved RGB PNGs; no interpolation reanalysis, latent inspection, inference, GPU, cloud runtime, or new generation.

baseline_threshold.name: red_rgb_threshold
limitations: This color mask is a screening proxy, not ground-truth segmentation.
Red reflections or unrelated red pixels can affect area and box measurements.
This fixed-depth, fixed-camera test does not establish metric 3D scale or physical dynamics.

matched_comparison_assessment.nominal_pair: CogVideoX-2B 8-step and 30-step outputs share recorded prompt, seed, resolution, and frame count, but both fail the fixed proxy full-track gate; checkpoint/revision, run code, and effective initial-noise provenance are absent.
matched_comparison_assessment.other_confounders: CogVideoX 50-step output differs in frame count and resolution. Wan retry4/retry5 are exact RGB replay duplicates, not independent clips; retry4 has incomplete instrumentation. Wan and CogVideoX use different backbones/settings.

smallest_informative_followup.design: After the current saved-Wan two-rater annotation screen and fresh free-T4 admission, run two additional unique seeds under the exact pinned M0 Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B configuration (same prompt, 832x480, 17 frames, 30 steps, guidance 5.0, scheduler and revision fixed). Together with the existing seed-2026 clip this gives three unique full sequences for a small exploratory robustness screen.
smallest_informative_followup.generation_unit: Jointly denoise one complete 17-frame sequence per seed; save/hash all decoded frames and run manifests.
smallest_informative_followup.primary_readout: Score every decoded frame with blinded human visibility/count/identity and tight-box-midpoint labels; apply the existing agreement/review gates unchanged. Report metrics by clip/seed, not by pooling frames as independent samples.
smallest_informative_followup.secondary_readout: On those same complete per-frame labels, calculate the existing five-anchor schedule as a secondary sparse-summary diagnostic; do not omit frames from primary scoring.
smallest_informative_followup.interpretation: Exploratory only; it cannot satisfy or replace the registered observer-release gate (three development blocks followed by five fresh held-out blocks, with its existing annotation and observer thresholds). Do not include a chunked arm absent measured resource/control-horizon pressure.
smallest_informative_followup.compute_estimate: Two additional M0-like generations are about 320 seconds (5.3 minutes) of generation-only T4 time at the measured 160.02 seconds per baseline run, excluding setup, model download, labeling, and artifact I/O. Requires fresh free-runtime admission; no paid compute.
